brand_name_similarity.description: Normalized Levenshtein/RapidFuzz similarity between handle and brand name

canonical_similarity.description: Similarity after resolving leetspeak and homoglyphs

has_homoglyphs.description: Binary flag indicating presence of homoglyph or character substitution

brand_in_handle.description: Binary flag if brand name is an exact substring of handle

deceptive_keyword_count.description: Count of deceptive keywords (support, official, claims, verify) found

max_official_handle_similarity.description: Maximum similarity to any known official handle

is_exact_official_match.description: 1 if handle exactly matches an official verified handle, else 0

domain_similarity.description: Similarity between target apex domain and registered official domain

is_punycode_domain.description: 1 if domain uses xn-- punycode, else 0

subdomain_spoof_flag.description: 1 if brand name is in subdomain of an unrelated apex domain

uses_https.description: 1 if target URL uses HTTPS, else 0
